[{"id":5117717742,"body":"the JETSAM_REASON_MEMORY_IDLE_EXIT lines nearby are worth pinning down, because they change whose bug this is: sudo log show --predicate \u0026#39;subsystem == \u0026#34;com.apple.runningboard\u0026#34;\u0026#39; --last 6h shows whether macos itself killed the helper (jetsam on a 16GB machine under compose plus tests is very plausible) or whether it died on its own. either way, containers vanishing from docker ps -a while their images survive is the scary part: that is a crash-consistency gap in the metadata store, and it means anything not in a backed-up named volume can evaporate mid-run. worth attaching the runningboard output here, a jetsam-confirmed report usually gets triaged differently than \u0026#34;it crashed\u0026#34;.\n\ndev line: i build a mac app that watches containers on always-on macs and pushes a diagnosed fix to your phone when something dies. free beta: https://youtu.be/bx_OhpNysiM","html_url":"https://github.com/orbstack/orbstack/issues/2601#issuecomment-5117717742","user":{"login":"andreimotin","id":118438044,"profile_url":"https://github.com/andreimotin","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/118438044?v=4"},"author_association":"NONE","reactions":{"total_count":0,"+1":0,"-1":0,"laugh":0,"confused":0,"heart":0,"hooray":0,"rocket":0,"eyes":0},"created_at":"2026-07-29T12:26:08Z","updated_at":"2026-07-29T12:26:08Z"},{"id":5143038730,"body":"I can now confirm the macOS Jetsam path for the same class of SIGKILL on another 16 GiB host.\n\nEnvironment:\n- OrbStack 2.2.1 (`0e182b501fcd9e05b99ffb363fce03610390c400`)\n- macOS 26.5.1 (25F80)\n- Apple M1 Mac mini, 16 GiB\n- OrbStack limit: 4 CPUs / 6144 MiB, Kubernetes disabled\n- 47 Docker containers running at the time\n\nAt 2026-07-31 11:26:54 local time the kernel logged the victim and reason explicitly:\n\n```text\nmemorystatus: killing largest compressed process OrbStack Helper [58077] 56616 MB\n```\n\nThe helper was reported exited one second later, while the OrbStack GUI process stayed alive. OrbStack saved `unified-kill.log`, started replacement helper PID 66751 with `vmgr ... -handoff` at 11:27:57, and Docker was running again at 11:28:06. There was no normal vmgr shutdown or current crash report.\n\nmacOS had performed sustained Jetsam cleanup immediately beforehand. Concurrent Forgejo CI/container activity and a short-lived LaunchAgent respawn storm likely reduced headroom, but the direct reason and selected victim are established by the kernel line above.\n\nThe previous helper had been alive for five days. Historical samples showed host RSS growing from roughly 860 MiB to 4.1 GiB, with a maximum around 4.55 GiB. The replacement helper also uses roughly 2–4 GiB RSS under load. The `56616 MB` compressed-process attribution is especially notable given the configured 6144 MiB OrbStack limit.\n\nDiagnostic report generated after the investigation:\nhttps://orbstack.dev/_admin/diag/orbstack-diagreport_2026-07-31T12-28-19.135096Z.zip\n\nThis report includes `unified-kill.log`, `gui.log`, `vmgr.1.log`, `vmgr.log`, vmgr samples/profiles, and configuration. I did not observe Docker metadata loss after this recovery.\n","html_url":"https://github.com/orbstack/orbstack/issues/2601#issuecomment-5143038730","user":{"login":"patlux","id":4481570,"profile_url":"https://github.com/patlux","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/4481570?v=4"},"author_association":"NONE","reactions":{"total_count":0,"+1":0,"-1":0,"laugh":0,"confused":0,"heart":0,"hooray":0,"rocket":0,"eyes":0},"created_at":"2026-07-31T12:50:33Z","updated_at":"2026-07-31T12:50:33Z"},{"id":5303802208,"body":"32 GB / macOS 26.2 / OrbStack 2.2.3.
